in_sanskrit.name: Nepal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Home of the Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nepal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Nepal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nepa' meaning lord or ruler and 'Alaya' meaning home. The name is a reflection of the belief that the land is the home of various gods and goddesses.

in_marathi.name: Nepal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Home of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nepal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nepal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nepa' meaning lord or ruler and 'Alaya' meaning home. The name is a reflection of the belief that the land is the home of various gods and goddesses.

in_bengali.name: Nepal
